atoms.text: In 1999, they were worried about something called 'the millennium bug'. They thought there might be computer problems. People thought they wouldn’t be able to tell the difference between the year 1900 and 2000. Luckily, they worked hard to make sure everything would work. There weren’t many problems in the end.
